title: JAK'D Cyber Rabbit Xenon 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Xenon from Jak’d and Cyber Rabbit offers is deliciously intriguing blend of tart Pomegranate and sweet Blueberry. Discover this tantalising fusion that couples the unique tang of pomegranate with the sweet, mellow notes of blueberry. Xenon offers a truly unique taste experience, filled with tangy, vibrant notes that invigorate the senses. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods and sub-ohm tanks. Shortfills offer vapers a fantastic way to save money on their favourite flavours while having full control over their e-liquid’s nicotine content. Ideal for use with advanced sub-ohm vape kits, which commonly consume e-liquids faster, Shortfills help your favourite e-liquids last and last. Designed for vapers who like to double down on flavour, Jak'd delivers more than just the usual e-liquid. Every bottle offers a robust, amplified taste that sets it apart in the market. For those ready to elevate their vaping experience to new heights, Jak'd e-liquids are inspired by some of the best flavours from such legendary brands as Jack Rabbit, Cyber Rabbit, Okay Orange!, Japanta and Unreal and are available in long-lasting 100ml Shortfills and super-satisfying Nic Salts.
